breakdown.description: The prompt sets the torsional shear stress to zero at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly removes the erroneous instruction that the torsional shear stress vanishes at the outer surface. Instead, it properly computes the torsional shear stress τ at the outer surface using τ = Tc/J and uses it in the plane stress analysis (τxy = τ), which aligns with the ground truth prompt. The incorrect statement from the incomplete prompt is not repeated.
